title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace Drop: Grumman AA-5, Eviation Alice & Massive PMDG Liveries!
description:
Are you looking to expand your Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 hangar this week, or are you trying to decide which new Marketplace add-ons are worth your investment? Today, we are breaking down a massive slate of new releases spanning multi-era General Aviation classics and all-electric commuter aircraft to deep rotorcraft overhauls, quirky novelties, and a colossal drop of official PMDG liveries!

In this marketplace breakdown, we take a close look at specs, system depth, aircraft variants, and new releases across the MSFS 2024 virtual flight line:

✈️ PRIMARY AIRCRAFT RELEASES
We kick things off with Blue Sky Hangar's Grumman AA-5 series, bringing three distinct variants—the Traveler, Cheetah, and Tiger. We examine its 4 unique cockpit configurations (from the 1970s factory layout to modern IFR avionics and Garmin G1000 glass), career mode readiness, walkaround support, and VR integration. Next, we check out the all-electric Eviation Alice by Sim Federation, featuring simulated battery depletion dynamics, commuter passenger/cargo layouts, and high-tech avionics. We also assess the RM Studios Boeing 737 MAX 10—including an honest look at expectations vs. study-level options—and a quick look at 4Simmers' novelty Paper Plane rental.

🚁 BUNDLES, ROTORCRAFT & MARINE SIMULATIONS
Looking to expand your bush and utility fleet? We inspect the Got Friends Legacy Collection, bringing together favorites like the Savage Carbon, Savage Gravel, Monster NX Cub, and Vertigo into one package. For rotary-wing pilots, DHM releases the Pilot Experience Pack for the CowanSim R22, delivering realistic engine damage logic, calibrated CHT/EGT needles, reworked weight-and-balance, and native teetering/coning rotor dynamics. Plus, we take a look at the unusual marine drops from Rodrigo Morales, including the historic RMS Titanic, Olympic, and Britannic ocean liners, the 35ft Speedboat, and Got Friends' Man's Best Friend Deluxe companion add-on.

🧭 AVIONICS, COCKPIT UTILITIES & PMDG LIVERIES
Need modern navigation or procedural discipline in the cockpit? We showcase RM Studios' portable Garmin G5 + Aera 500 navigation setup ported to MSFS 2024, alongside VA Systems' dedicated A320 Family step-by-step checklist app. Finally, we break down the colossal wave of official PMDG liveries hitting the Marketplace—spanning the DC-6 series, 737-600/700/900 packs, and the 777-200ER fleet—including essential advice on Marketplace purchases for Xbox pilots vs. free installs via the PMDG Operations Center on PC.

Which of these releases are you taking up first? Taking the Grumman AA-5 on a cross-country flight, testing your power management in the Eviation Alice, or flying line routes in the new PMDG liveries? Let us know in the comments below!

If you find these marketplace breakdowns helpful, don't forget to hit the like button, subscribe for weekly flight sim coverage, and clear skies on your next flight!
